title: SQL Mission 8: Pagination With Keyset Filter

-- User scrolled past the first page.
-- Cursor: order_date = '2025-10-01', order_id = 4500
--
-- Rules:
--   1. Use keyset filter to get "older" rows
--   2. Handle date ties with order_id
--   3. Return next 20 rows
--   4. Sort order must match WHERE predicate
--
-- Table: orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, total_amount)

SELECT
  order_id,
  order_date,
  total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE
  -- TODO: keyset condition using '2025-10-01' and 4500
ORDER BY order_date DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 20;
